text: Uno-X Mobility and REMA 1000 are brands of Reitan Retail, the Reitan group's retail company in the Nordic and Baltic countries; Reitan Retail says Uno-X Mobility owns and operates the professional cycling team with both women's and men's teams.
short: Uno-X Mobility and REMA 1000 are Reitan Retail brands.

source.name: Reitan Retail: Our business
source.quote: great brands including REMA 1000, Narvesen, R-kioski, Pressbyrån, 7-Eleven og Uno-X Mobility
source.note: Same page: 'Uno-X Mobility is also passionate about cycling, and proudly owns and operates a professional cycling team with both women's and men's teams.'
